---
name: Documentation correction
about: Report an inaccurate public planning statement
title: "[Docs] "
---

**Product or document:** Provide its exact VSG name and public path.

**What is incorrect:** Quote only the necessary non-sensitive text.

**Evidence:** Link to official documentation or reproducible public information, with date.

**Proposed correction:** Describe the smallest justified change.

Do not include credentials, customer information, private repository links or undisclosed security vulnerabilities.
